## Company Overview
Nexzoa is an AI software technology company based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, founded in 2024. Nexzoa builds proprietary AI-powered SaaS platforms alongside bespoke software engineering solutions, intelligent workflow automation pipelines, and high-performance cloud applications for startups, scaleups, and enterprises globally.

## Proprietary Products
1. BookingPartner.lk (Flagship Mobility SaaS): Transportation booking and partner management platform connecting passengers, bus operators, and booking agents across Sri Lanka. Built with real-time seat reservation engines and Anthropic Claude passenger assistance. Status: Active Development / Private MVP.
2. QuickSticker AI Studio: AI-powered sticker generator and background removal platform for creators and brands. Status: Live Product.
3. QuickCompress Optimizer: Client-side bulk image compression and format optimization tool with zero cloud retention. Status: Live Utility.

## Core Services
1. AI Software Engineering: Custom LLM pipelines, autonomous multi-agent systems, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, intelligent document processing, and vector search integrations.
2. Custom SaaS Development: End-to-end multi-tenant SaaS products engineered with Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and scalable cloud backends.
3. AI Workflow Automation: Bespoke internal automation pipelines, CRM/ERP database synchronization, webhook architectures, and custom n8n/Zapier replacement engines.
4. Full-Stack Web Architecture: High-performance web applications built for speed (<100ms TTFB), conversion, and enterprise security.
5. Realtime Dashboard & Analytics Systems: Executive BI dashboards, IoT telemetry interfaces, and event-driven data streaming.

## Engineering Philosophy & USP
- Direct Engineering: Zero non-technical account managers or agency overhead; clients collaborate directly with senior software architects.
- Sub-100ms Performance: Systems engineered for sub-100ms TTFB and 95+ Core Web Vitals scores.
- Clean Architecture: Modular, typed, production-ready codebases with comprehensive automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend & Runtimes: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Express
- Databases & Cache: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Upstash, Prisma, Drizzle ORM
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Vercel, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Cloudflare
- AI & LLM Frameworks: OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, pgvector

## Regional Focus
- Saudi Arabia: Vision 2030 digital transformation, Monsha'at SME digitization, ZATCA e-invoicing compliance support, AST timezone alignment.
- Dubai & UAE: DIFC FinTech platforms, real estate PropTech, fast-track MVP sprints, GST timezone alignment.
- Qatar: Qatar National Vision 2030, enterprise modernization, logistics and smart city infrastructure.
- Global & Sri Lanka: Global startup MVPs and host of the authoritative Sri Lanka Tech Ecosystem Directory.
